dialogues.speaker: Adieta
dialogues.text: Mom, it's clear to see how much you worry about Dad, and now we've sneaked out here to see him. Why don't you just admit to yourself that you've forgiven him?

dialogues.speaker: Adieta
dialogues.text: Dad's always saying how actions are worth more than words when it comes to showing you're sorry... Sometimes, I think adults are more childish than children.
